info.name: English Meaning
info.value: to be happy, to be tired, to be intoxicated

info.name: DAturUpanandinIwippaRI
info.value: glepanam = dEnyam ' iti mA.DA.vfttiH . ' glapane ' iti kzIrataraNgiRyAM pAWaH . ' stUtyAdO mandate, harze mAdyet , mAdayate Rici ' (Slo. 112) iti devaH .

examples: 'dyUte pAne taTA strIzu mfgayAyAM ca yo naraH. na pramAdyati mohAt…' (BA॰SAM॰288.26).. dyUte ityAdayaH sAmIpye saptamyaH. na pramAdyati AtmAnaM vismftya tatrABinivizwo na BavatItyarTaH.
'mA jIveByaH pramadaH' (aTarva॰8.1.7). prapUrvo madiranavaDAne vartate. anavahito mA sma BUrityAha.
'daSa DarmaM na jAnanti DftarAzwra niboDa tAn. mattaH pramatta unmattaH…' (BA॰u॰33.101). pramatto'navahitaH.
'yanti pramAdamatandrAH' (aTarva॰20.18.3). pramAdaM prakarzeRa mAdayitAraM tasya madakaraM somam iti sAyaRaH.
'vimattamiva hi tO tayA nirakurutAm' (E0 brA0 2.22). ukto'rTaH.
'nizevya pAnaM madanIyamuttamaM niSAvivAsezu cirAd vimAdyati' (sOndara0 9.29). vimAdyati vigatamado Bavati.
'unmAdyati sa tu kzipraM taM tu devagrahaM viduH' (BA0 vana0 230.47).
'daSa DarmaM na jAnanti…mattaH pramatta unmattaH' (BA0 u0 33.102).
'ati janaM vA gacCedudvA mAdyeta' (paYca0 brA0 18.11.10). unmAdyeta unmAdyet unmAdamupeyAt.
'kAnana'sminvinA kAntAM cittamunmAdayanti me' (rA0 4.1.97). unmAdayanti unmattamudBrAntaM kurvanti.
'yaTedamapyetarhi jYAtInAM yaM garizWe (karmaRi) yuYjanti tamupamadanti' (Sa0 brA0 1.4.2.1). upamadanti stuvanti.
